properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued November 8 at 12:10AM PST until November 10 at 10:00PM PST by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Minor to locally moderate coastal flooding expected.
Additionally, dangerous rip currents and surf of 3 to 7 feet
expected along west-facing beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until noon PST Tuesday.
For the Beach Hazards Statement, from 4 AM PST this morning
through Tuesday evening.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of parking lots and roads with only isolated
road closures expected. Dangerous swimming conditions due to
elevated surf and strong rip currents.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highest tides will occur in the late
morning each day, peaking at 7.4-7.6 feet Sunday and Monday,
which is 1.3 to 1.6 feet above astronomical tide predictions.
Surf will be highest at 4-7 feet Monday, which may prolong some
of the coastal impacts.
properties.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property. Stay off of sea walls and jetties. Remain farther back
from the ocean, as waves will run farther up the beach than
expected, especially during high and rising tides.

Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions. If
you do get in the water, always swim near a lifeguard.

NWSheadline: COASTAL FLOOD ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL NOON PST TUESDAY... ...BEACH HAZARDS STATEMENT IN EFFECT FROM 4 AM PST EARLY THIS MORNING THROUGH TUESDAY EVENING
